description: Labeled holder-structure diff for a Robinhood Chain token: who FROZE (to the wei), who added, who trimmed, who exited over ~24h — each notable wallet carries whatever RobinX knows about it (insider-linked extraction record, deployer record, ENS + Farcaster identity with multi-wallet entities collapsed, round-number off-market flags; a wallet with no record carries no label) + a structure verdict: rotation vs top-distribution vs accumulation.
